description: Posts on the workspace's accounts that weren't made in Chockstone (made in the network's own app, or before the account connected), by when they went out, for the calendar. Stories are left out. from and to are ISO times; at most 200, oldest first. Use an id with post_results_get for its numbers.

from.description: Start of the range, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z

to.description: End of the range, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-31T23:59:59Z

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: calendar_history
title: Posts made outside the app
